question:
What is the name of the organic compound in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e65e8522bad30f39d43b2b984de8c043fae069e1642687f6792ef3bd451d056.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aniline**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Aniline is an aromatic compound with the formula C6H5NH2.
 
• It has a benzene ring attached to an amine group and is the simplest aromatic amine.
 
• Aniline is basic in nature because it has a lone pair of electrons for donation on its nitrogen atom.
 
• Aniline is moderately soluble in water and is soluble in organic solvents like toluene, benzene, alcohol, chloroform, etc.
 
• Pure aniline is a colorless liquid and appears oily. It has a fishy kind of smell.
 
• Aniline has a melting point of -60C and a boiling point of 1840C. It is denser than water.
 
• Aniline is a base and is thus used to make dyes, drugs, explosives, plastics, and photography materials.
 
• Aniline causes irritation to the respiratory tract, eyes, and skin and can cause damage to red blood cells.
 
• Aniline is synthesized by the reduction of nitrobenzene with Sn/HCl.
 
• 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b5e796efb884725102259389364efe4b01bc180263becf21e282c03fdb216d0.png] 

 
 
• Aniline undergoes acylation, alkylation, and diazotization.
